items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: we had Darnell Howard on fiddle, and Jimmy Mundy on fiddle

ctx.x: Yeah, that first band we had was a great band, because we had two fiddles, we had Darnell Howard on fiddle, and Jimmy Mundy on fiddle, and we had Cecil Irwin on clarinet, and whatscallum on clarinet.
